leadText: Hayden (Japanese: ハシバ Hashiba) is a Pokémon Trainer from Fuchsia City.
plainText:
Hayden (Japanese: ハシバ Hashiba) is a Pokémon Trainer from Fuchsia City.

==In animation==
In , Hayden is a character of the day who appeared in Caring for a Mystery!.

Hayden met and Goh while they were searching for a Pokémon Egg. Hayden challenged Ash to a Normal Class World Coronation Series , which Ash accepted. Hayden sent out his to battle but was defeated, causing his rank to go down.

===Pokémon===
 

===Achievements===
Hayden has competed in the following competitions:

World Coronation Series Rank: 1,024 (Normal Class)

===Voice actors===
 

==In the manga==
 
===Pokémon Journeys===
Hayden appeared in Caring for a Mystery!. In the manga, Hayden is just an regular Trainer that Ash battled in a normal battle unrelated to the World Coronation Series.

====Pokémon====
 

==Trivia==
Hayden wears items that refer to his Pokémon; a headband with a drawing of 's horns and a vest with cords resembling the tails of a Tauros.
Hayden's Japanese voice actor, Yasuhiro Mamiya, was born in . , the real-life counterpart of Fuchsia City, is also located in Chiba.
